Flight Information Service (FIS) provided. Two-way radio communication mandatory. All traffic operating in RMZ1 shall notify Pristina Approach about their intention. Essential information (position, altitude, etc.) shall be made available by aircraft to BKPR APP unit.
NORTH DEFINED BY THE FOLLOWING HORIZONTAL POINTS/COORDINATES
All traffic operating on RMZ2 North are required to contact Prishtina Approach
SOUTH DEFINED BY THE FOLLOWING HORIZONTAL POINTS/COORDINATES

Purpose: KFOR/NATO flight operations. Conditions of Use: • Area reserved for KFOR/NATO use only. • IFR flights are permitted to operate within the restricted area between 5700 FT AMSL and FL205. • No VFR flights or UAS operations are allowed within the restricted area.
RESTRICTED AIRSPACE FOR KFOR / NATO USE ONLY. INFORMATION ON EFFECTIVE ACTIVATION WILL BE PROVIDED BY PRISTINA ATC.
Activated on tactical basis. Information on effective activation will be provided by Pristina ATC.

Training Area for KFOR/NATO use only. Outside Prishtina CTR, no IFR and VFR flights allowed to enter Training Area, unless authorized by KFOR/NATO. Within Prishtina CTR, no civilian VFR flights allowed to enter Training Area, unless authorised by KFOR/NATO.

Activity: Used limited basis between sunrise and sunset by KFOR rotary wing aircraft to conduct in flight maintenance checks. This area is not restrictive in nature but depicted for advisory purposes. Participating aircraft use 129.0mhz (KFOR traffic advisory frequency).

Activation time will be announced by NOTAM The Paragliders/Gliders must reserve these areas at least 72 hrs in advance prior to flying through Pristina ATS and J3 Air Desk respectively. The Paragliders/Gliders must provide a cellular phone number of their POC to Pristina ATS and J3 Air Desk KFOR HQ and be available during the flying activity. Pristina ATS shall advise aircrews when the area is active. J3 Air Desk retains the authority to cancel flight execution in this area.
